title: Topic 18: Clothes & Colours - Speaking
description: Recorded speaking task, teacher-graded against a 4-criterion rubric.
canDoStatement: Name clothes and colours; describe what people are wearing

speakingTask.speakingPrompt:
Record a 60-second monologue: CLOTHES AND COLOURS.
Cover:
1. What you are wearing RIGHT NOW - with colours
(I am wearing...)
2. What you wear every day to work/school - the habit
(I wear...)
3. One person: what he/she is wearing now, or wears
every day (T4 + T3: describe a real person!)
4. Your favorite colour + one thing you have in that
colour

Tip: Look at yourself - real clothes, real colours.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic18_clothes_colours.txt, Lesson 18.4. XP 15 on submit, +10 on approval.

criteria.title: am/is wearing vs wear used correctly
